title: 逆运动学根据末端位置计算机械臂关节
posterTitle: 末端目标位置决定各关节转角
posterHook: 拖住发光的手爪任意挪动——FABRIK 迭代像把绳子拉直再一节一节装回去；关节限位、肘上肘下双解、够不着就伸直指向，全是真的。
question: 你只说手要到哪儿，机械臂怎么知道每个关节转多少？

en.title: Inverse kinematics solves robot joints from an end position
en.posterTitle: An end-effector target determines each joint angle
en.posterHook: Drag the glowing gripper anywhere — FABRIK iterates like pulling a rope straight and reattaching it link by link. Joint limits, elbow-up and elbow-down branches, and an honest straight reach for what it cannot touch: all real.
en.question: You only say where the hand should go — how does the arm know how much each joint turns?
